ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نٓ‌ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ ۝١
ayahs.translation: Nūn.[1724] By the pen and what they inscribe,
ayahs.translationClear: Noon. By the pen, and by what they inscribe.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
ayahs.translationClear: By the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.translationClear: In fact, you will have a reward that will never end.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ ۝٤
ayahs.translation: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
ayahs.translationClear: And you are of a great moral character.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ ۝٥
ayahs.translation: So you will see and they will see
ayahs.translationClear: You will see, and they will see.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ ۝٦
ayahs.translation: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
ayahs.translationClear: Which of you is the afflicted.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهٖࣕ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee wahuwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best the well-guided.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: Then do not obey the deniers.
ayahs.translationClear: So do not obey the deniers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
ayahs.translationClear: They would like you to compromise, so they would compromise.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
ayahs.translationClear: And do not obey any vile swearer.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ ۝١١
ayahs.translation: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
ayahs.translationClear: Backbiter, spreader of slander.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ ۝١٢
ayahs.translation: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
ayahs.translationClear: Preventer of good, transgressor, sinner.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ ۝١٣
ayahs.translation: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.[1725]

footnotes.1725: i.e., claiming a particular lineage falsely. The description given in these verses is of al-Waleed bin al-Mugheerah (see also 74:11-25) or possibly, as asserted by Ibn Katheer, al-Akhnas bin Shurayq.

ayahs.translationClear: Rude and fake besides.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ ۝١٤
ayahs.translation: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
ayahs.translationClear: Just because he has money and children.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذَا تُتْلٰي عَلَيْهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.translationClear: When Our Verses are recited to him, he says, “Myths of the ancients!”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ ۝١٦
ayahs.translation: We will brand him upon the snout.[1726]

footnotes.1726: Literally, "trunk," meaning the nose of an elephant or pig.

ayahs.translationClear: We will brand him on the muzzle.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا بَلَوْنٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا͏ٓ اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِۚ اِذْ اَقْسَمُوْا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa balawnaahum kamaa balawnaa as'haabal-jannati idh aqsamoo layasrimunnahaa musbiheen
ayahs.translationClear: We tested them, as We tested the owners of the garden, when they vowed to harvest it in the morning.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ ۝١٨
ayahs.translation: Without making exception.[1727]

footnotes.1727: i.e., without conceding that nothing can be accomplished unless Allāh wills, saying, "...if Allāh wills" ("in-shā’-Allāh"). See 18:23-24.

ayahs.translationClear: Without any reservation.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَا࢜ىِٕفٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَا࢜ىِٕمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
ayahs.transliteration: Fataafa 'alayhaa taa'ifum mir rabbika wahum naa'imoon
ayahs.translationClear: But a calamity from your Lord went around it while they slept.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: And it became as though reaped.
ayahs.translationClear: And in the morning it was as if picked.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: And they called one another at morning,
ayahs.translationClear: In the morning, they called to one another.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَنِ اغْدُوْا عَلٰي حَرْثِكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
ayahs.translationClear: “Go early to your plantation, if you are going to harvest.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
ayahs.translationClear: So off they went, murmuring to one another.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَنْ لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّسْكِيْنٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
ayahs.translationClear: “No poor person is to enter it upon you today.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.[1728]

footnotes.1728: To carry out their plan, confident of their ability.

ayahs.translationClear: And early they went, resolved in intent.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
ayahs.translationClear: But when they saw it, they said, “We were wrong.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.translation: Rather, we have been deprived."
ayahs.translationClear: We are now deprived.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اَوْسَطُهُمْ اَلَمْ اَقُلْ لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"[1729]
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawlaa tusabbihoon

footnotes.1729: i.e., remember or mention Him by saying, "...if Allāh wills." An additional meaning is "praise" or "thank" Him for His bounty.

ayahs.translationClear: The most reasonable of them said, “Did I not say to you, ‘If only you would glorify’?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّنَا͏ٓ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo subhaana rabbinaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Glory to our Lord—we were indeed in the wrong.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
ayahs.translationClear: Then they turned to one another, blaming one another.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.translation: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Woe to us—we were indeed domineering.

ayahs.textUthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: عَسٰي رَبُّنَا͏ٓ اَنْ يُّبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا͏ٓ اِنَّا͏ٓ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا رٰغِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."[1730]
ayahs.transliteration: 'asaa rabbunaa an yubdilanaa khayram minhaa innaa ilaa rabbinaa raaghiboon

footnotes.1730: Of His mercy, forgiveness and bounty.

ayahs.translationClear: Perhaps our Lord will give us a better substitute for it. We are turning to our Lord.”

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ‌ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ‌ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.transliteration: Kadhaalikal-'adhaabu wala'adhaabul-aakhirati akbaru law kaanoo ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Such is the punishment; but the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
ayahs.translationClear: For the righteous are Gardens of Delight with their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
ayahs.translationClear: Shall We treat the Muslims like the villains?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
ayahs.translationClear: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.translation: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
ayahs.translationClear: Or do you have a scripture in which you study.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
ayahs.translationClear: Wherein there is whatever you choose?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَكُمْ اَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ اِلٰي يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِۙ اِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
ayahs.transliteration: Am lakum aymaanun 'alaynaa baalighatun ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do you have oaths from Us, binding until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you demand?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ ۝٤٠
ayahs.translation: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
ayahs.translationClear: Ask them, which of them will guarantee that.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَا࢜ءُۚۛ فَلْيَاْتُوْا بِشُرَكَا࢜ىِٕهِمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they have partners?[1731] Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.transliteration: Am lahum shurakaa'u falya'too bishurakaa'ihim in kaanoo saadiqeen

footnotes.1731: i.e., those to whom they attribute divinity other than Allāh or partners from among themselves.

ayahs.translationClear: Or do they have partners? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَّيُدْعَوْنَ اِلَي السُّجُوْدِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: The Day the shin will be uncovered[1732] and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yukshafu 'an saaqin wayud'awna ilas-sujoodi falaa yastatee'oon

footnotes.1732: i.e., when everyone will find before him great difficulty. In accordance with authentic ḥadīths, "the shin" might also refer to that of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā), before which every believer will prostrate on the Day of Judgement. See footnote to 2:19.

ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called to bow down, but they will be unable.

ayahs.textUthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ‌ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: خَاشِعَةً اَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌؕ وَقَدْ كَانُوْا يُدْعَوْنَ اِلَي السُّجُوْدِ وَهُمْ سٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.[1733]
ayahs.transliteration: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kaanoo yud'awna ilas-sujoodi wahum saalimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. They were invited to bow down when they were sound.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ‌ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَذَرْنِيْ وَمَنْ يُّكَذِّبُ بِهٰذَا الْحَدِيْثِؕ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.[1734]
ayahs.transliteration: Fadharnee waman yukadhdhibu bihaadhal-hadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu laa ya'lamoon

footnotes.1734: Allāh will increase His favors to them in this world by way of trial, whereby they will sink deeper into sin and thus into destruction.

ayahs.translationClear: So leave Me to those who reject this discourse; We will proceed against them gradually, from where they do not know.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ ۝٤٥
ayahs.translation: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
ayahs.translationClear: And I will give them respite. My plan is firm.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ تَسْـٔ͏َلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.transliteration: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim muthqaloon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do you ask them for a fee, so they are burdened with debt?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.translation: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they know the future, and so they write it down?

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنْ كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوْتِۘ اِذْ نَادٰي وَهُوَ مَكْظُوْمٌ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
ayahs.transliteration: Fasbir lihukmi rabbika walaa takun kasaahibil-hooti idh naadaa wahuwa makzoom
ayahs.translationClear: So wait patiently for the decision of your Lord, and do not be like the Fellow of the Fish who cried out in despair.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لَوْلَا͏ٓ اَنْ تَدٰرَكَهٗ نِعْمَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَا࢜ءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُوْمٌ

words.translation: surely he would have been thrown

ayahs.translation: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.[1735]
ayahs.transliteration: Lawlaa an tadaarakahoo ni'matum mir rabbihee lanubidha bil-'araa'i wahuwa madhmoom

footnotes.1735: But instead, Allāh accepted his repentance and provided means for his recovery. See 37:139-148.

ayahs.translationClear: Were it not for his Lord’s favor that reached him, he would have been thrown into the wilderness, fully despised.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.translation: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
ayahs.translationClear: But his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ يَّكَادُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَيُزْلِقُوْنَكَ بِاَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّهٗ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ ۘ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in yakaadul-ladheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka bi'absaarihim lammaa sami'udh-dhikra wayaqooloona innahoo lamajnoon
ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve almost stab you with their glances when they hear the message, and say, “He is crazy!”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.translation: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.translationClear: But it is no less than a reminder to all the Worlds.
